entries: Termination due to Discontinuance of Business

blocks.title: Parties and Background
items: This contract is made on the {{document.issue_date_legal}} between **{{company.legal_name_with_associates}}**, of {{company.address_inline}} (the **Company**), and **{{worker.full_name}}**, of {{worker.address_inline}} (the **{{engagement.party_term}}**).

blocks.title: Commencement Date and Term
items: The engagement starts on {{employment.start_date_long}} (the **Start Date**).
The first {{engagement.assessment_months}} months are the {{engagement.assessment_label}}. During it either party may end the engagement by giving {{employment.notice_text}}.

blocks.title: Programme Duration and Potential Conversion
items: {{engagement.conversion_paragraph}}

blocks.title: Job Title and Description
items: The {{engagement.party_term}} is engaged as **{{role.title}}**, reporting to {{employment.reports_to}}.
{{employment.duties_paragraph}}
The {{engagement.party_term}} will also carry out other reasonable duties that fit the role, set out in the Job Description.

blocks.title: Remuneration
items: The {{engagement.remuneration_label}} is {{employment.pay_statement}}.
The Company will make the deductions the law requires. Any bonus is discretionary. Reasonable business expenses approved in advance are reimbursed under the expenses policy.

blocks.title: Place of Work
items: The {{engagement.party_term}}'s work arrangement is {{employment.work_arrangement}}{{employment.work_location_suffix}}.

blocks.title: Time of Work
items: Normal working time is {{engagement.work_schedule}}.

items.text: Work may also be required on {{engagement.saturday_rule}}.

blocks.title: Duty to Devote Full Time
items: The {{engagement.party_term}} will devote full working time to the role, record working time in {{company.time_tracking_tool}}, and submit a Daily Work Report each working day to {{company.reports_email}}{{company.reports_channel}}.

blocks.title: Conflict of Interest
items: The {{engagement.party_term}} must disclose any outside activity as set out in the Affidavit of Employment Exclusivity.

blocks.title: Non-Solicitation
items: For {{company.non_solicit_months}} months after the engagement ends:

blocks.title: Confidential Information
items: Confidential Information has the meaning given in the Non-Disclosure Agreement signed with this contract. It does **not** include information the {{engagement.party_term}} develops without using Company equipment, Company time or Confidential Information, or that is or becomes public other than through a breach.

blocks.title: Duties regarding Confidential Information
items: The {{engagement.party_term}} must comply with the Non-Disclosure Agreement, which forms part of this contract.

blocks.title: Return of Confidential Information
items: When the engagement ends the {{engagement.party_term}} must return all Company property and Confidential Information.

blocks.title: Contract Binding Authority
items: The {{engagement.party_term}} may not enter into any contract on the Company's behalf unless authorised in writing.

blocks.title: Termination due to Discontinuance of Business
Termination of Engagement
items: Either party may end the engagement by giving {{employment.notice_text}}.

blocks.title: Severability
items: If any part of this contract cannot be enforced, the rest continues to apply.

blocks.title: Notices
items: Notices are given in writing to the Company at {{company.address_inline}} and to the {{engagement.party_term}} at {{worker.address_inline}}.

blocks.title: Modification
items: A change to this contract is valid only if it is in writing and signed by both parties.

blocks.title: Governing Law
items: This contract is governed by {{company.governing_law}}.

rows: The first {{engagement.assessment_months}} months of the engagement
As defined in the Non-Disclosure Agreement

blocks.title: General Provisions
items: This contract, Schedule 1, the Job Description and the Non-Disclosure Agreement form the whole agreement on these terms. Nothing in this contract removes a right the {{engagement.party_term}} has by law.

blocks.text: IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties have signed this contract on the {{document.issue_date_legal}}.
